native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'servo1': '0°', 'servo2': '0°', 'button': 'not pressed'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, both servos are set to 0° as per the requirement.'}

test2: {'time': 1.0, 'state': {'servo1': '180°', 'servo2': '0°', 'button': 'pressed once'}, 'description': 'First button press. After pressing the button, servo1 moves to 180° and servo2 moves to 0° (alternating from initial state).'}

test3: {'time': 1.5, 'state': {'servo1': '0°', 'servo2': '180°', 'button': 'pressed twice'}, 'description': 'Second button press. After pressing the button again, servo1 moves to 0° and servo2 moves to 180°, reversing their positions as per the toggle logic.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
